onboarding.description: Complete all steps to activate your expert profile.

practice.intro: Tell us where you are licensed to work and which languages you use with members. This shapes what you can offer publicly.
practice.serviceCountries: Where are you allowed to work?
practice.serviceCountriesHelp: Select every country where your licence lets you serve members. Your practice country is always included. Use Add or the EU preset for other ISO codes.
practice.legalHelper: You declared countries beyond your practice base. You remain responsible for holding a valid licence in each country you serve for clinical work.
practice.whyWeAskBody: Health regulation is national: a licence in one country does not automatically cover another. Worldwide remote is only for non-clinical work (coaching, mentoring).
practice.licenseScopeHelp: Optional now; required before admin approval for clinical offers.
practice.worldwideRemoteHelp: Lets you offer non-clinical sessions without a country limit. Clinical modes still follow the countries above.
